description: Queue a sync of the Stripe product catalog into the products list. Requires an active Stripe integration with bulk sync enabled. Pass integrationId when more than one Stripe account is connected; otherwise the most recently connected enabled account is used.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

integrationId.description: Stripe integration ID from list_integrations. Recommended when multiple Stripe accounts are connected.

name: sync_products

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `sync_products` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

job.description: The product sync job record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
